Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Aditya, what's the plan today?"

[Aditya throws the ball to Mother.]

Aditya: "Okay, Mom."

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Aditya (laughing): "That's great!"

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Aditya (surprised): "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Aditya: "Let's begin."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Anita: "Yes, all right."

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
